matches.text: LIFE AT UIPATH The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission The Engineering Systems team builds and maintains internal platform services, mission-critical for the entire engineering team. These services play a foundational role in accelerating the velocity of the engineering teams. What you'll do at UiPath - Plan, design, develop, and test software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products or features, including cloud-based tools. - Collaborate with teams across UiPath to design and engineer areas of our product and services. - Ensure technical deliverables meet customer expectations, and all requirements of quality, security, scalability, modifiability, extensibility, testability, etc. - Help establish effective and agile engineering practices. - Identify bottlenecks and bugs, devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues. - Plan feature development, design system components, and build engineering roadmap. - Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation. What you'll bring to the team - 5+ years experience in a Software Engineering role. - 1+ years experience in B2B software or technology industry. - Programming languages (C#, C, C++, Java, Python etc.) - Experience with Kubernetes. - Strong grasp of object-oriented programming and architectural design patterns. - Strong knowledge of multithreading, synchronization, asynchronous programming. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. closest.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (SDET)
closest.text: Uniphore is one of the largest B2B AI-native companies—decades-proven, built-for-scale and designed for the enterprise. The company drives business outcomes, across multiple industry verticals, and enables the largest global deployments. Uniphore infuses AI into every part of the enterprise that impacts the customer. We deliver the only multimodal architecture centered on customers that combines Generative AI, Knowledge AI, Emotion AI, workflow automation and a co-pilot to guide you. We understand better than anyone how to capture voice, video and text and how to analyze all types of data. As AI becomes more powerful, every part of the enterprise that impacts the customer will be disrupted. We believe the future will run on the connective tissue between people, machines and data: all in the service of creating the most human processes and experiences for customers and employees. Job Description: Key Responsibilities Lead QA strategy and roadmap for Uniphore’s AI and SaaS platforms, driving continuous improvements in automation, coverage, and release quality. Design and implement scalable automation frameworks for API, UI, and data validation testing. Expertise using AI tools for automation. Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to validate AI/ML workflows, analytics pipelines, and model integration within production environments. Lead efforts in performance, security, and regression testing, ensuring Uniphore’s enterprise platforms deliver reliability at scale. Perform root cause and trend analysis to identify process gaps and recommend automation or process enhancements. Document QA processes, release notes, and best practices in Confluence / Jira and maintain alignment with Agile/SAFe practices. Ensure end-to-end testing coverage across microservices, APIs, mobile, and web-based solutions in a multi-tenant cloud environment. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering 7–10+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including significant automation experience. Expert-level proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript). Ability to understand complex features, write quality test cases, and automation test scripts with the right level of validation and assertions. Strong hands-on experience creating and maintain custom test automation frameworks Experience testing complex systems for end-to-end, longevity, reliability, migration, and performance testing. Experience using building and deploying AI testing strategies for foundation models, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, Guidance etc) Deep understanding of CI/CD workflows and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI). Proven ability to understand complex, distributed systems and design test strategies for them Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Familiarity with microservices architectures and related testing methodologies. Experience with performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). Hands on experience with cloud platforms (GCP/AWS/Azure). Familiarity with at least one of them is ideal. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Prior mentorship or leadership experience in QA teams. Prior experience of testing data driven applications. Location preference: India - Bangalore Uniphore is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. For more information on how Uniphore uses AI to unify—and humanize—every enterprise experience, please visit www.uniphore.com.

Salary Tool Global Vs India Salary Comparison Tool For Companies For Talents About Resource Pricing Contact Hire Talent Find a Job When Should You Hire a Dedicated WordPress Developer Instead of Using a Theme? Kritika Verma October 9, 2025 6 Minute Read Imagine that you have just launched a product and your marketing team is firing on all cylinders and leads are rolling in. But your website? That’s slow, generic, and doesn’t convert traffic into action. That’s where you opt for the in-built WordPress themes for its fast setup and low cost. Sounds smart, but only until performance issues, customization roadblocks, and fragmented design start hurting your brand. Additionally, there’s a brutal truth for product companies: a 1-second delay in your page load speed can result in a 7% reduction in conversions. This is not simply a lag – but lost revenue, credibility, and momentum. So, how do you know that it’s finally time to move beyond a theme and hire top WordPress developers to bring speed, scalability, and a custom vibe to your website? In this blog, we will navigate that decision without overselling or underpaying the real business impact. Themes vs. Developer: A Smart Comparison Criteria Pre-Built WordPress Themes Dedicated WordPress Developer Definition & Use Cases Pre-designed templates can be a great option for basic blogs or quick MVPs. Custom-built sites are specifically crafted to resonate with your brand, UX goals, and business logic. Pros & Cons Pros: Fast to launch Low cost Readily available Cons: Generic design Inflexible Potential code bloat Pros: Full UX control Scalable Performance-optimized Cons: High investment up-front Longer delivery timeline Developer Role & Skills N/A Dedicated WordPress developer skills must include expertise in: PHP JavaScript HTML/CSS REST APIs Performance Security Freelancers Vs dedicated developers N/A While freelancers offer flexibility, dedicated WordPress developers offer speed, scalability, continuity, and quality. When a Theme Does the Job Sometimes a theme can prove to be the right choice. Ask yourself: Do you have a limited budget or are you in the early stages? Do you just require quick implementation and simple branding? Is an internet presence rather than a unique feature set your end goal? For startups, small businesses, and event-driven landing pages, themes promote faster rollouts with minimal cost. But for short-term or temporary solutions they remain as the best alternative. Limitations of Using Only a WordPress Theme The following theme limitations can potentially hamper your business growth: Lack of Scalability and Flexibility Pre-built themes are designed with a one-size-fits-all functionality. With your evolving business needs, you may find that the theme can’t accommodate advanced features, changing design needs, or integration with tools like CRMs or marketing platforms. This leaves no option but to either heavily customize the theme, often breaking it in the process or rebuilding from scratch wasting time and resources. Performance and SEO Challenges Themes are often packed with unnecessary features, scripts, and plugins that aren’t even relevant to the website’s use cases. This extra bloat tends to slow down your site, which has a direct impact on user experience and search engine rankings. In fact, according to Google page speed is one of the ranking factors and a delay of a micro second can have a negative bearing upon customer satisfaction. Security Risks and Code Bloat Free or poorly maintained themes offer an easy gateway to hackers, especially if there is heavy reliance on outdated code or unsupported plugins. Additionally, theme developers might not follow WordPress coding standards or properly sanitize user inputs, leading to vulnerabilities. On the other hand, custom development offers you full control over code quality, plugin dependencies, and security protocols. Key Signs You Should Hire a Dedicated WordPress Developer You must strongly consider hiring top WordPress developers if: You Need a Fully Custom Design/UI/UX Themes will limit your ability to create a distinct and on-brand experience. A developer can build pixel-perfect layouts that will reflect your vision and guide users more intentionally. You Require Complex Functionalities or Integrations If you need CRM integration, payment gateways, or custom dashboards themes can’t handle the complexity without breaking. Alternatively, a developer can build custom features that work reliably and scale as required. You are Scaling or Rebranding Your Business If you are growing fast or giving your brand a refresh, flexibility is a must. When it comes to rebrands or redesigns themes often don’t suffice. Whereas, a developer ensures that your site evolves smoothly with your business goals. You Want Better Site Speed, Performance, and SEO Speed and performance have a direct impact on SEO and user engagement. Themes are often bloated with unnecessary code, on the contrary a developer can streamline your site for fast loading, clean code, and higher rankings. You Need Ongoing Technical Support and Maintenance With themes you are on your own when things break. Developers offer consistent support, handle updates, and proactively maintain your site. This saves you time and prevents downtime. Cost Comparison: Themes vs. Developer Value Initial Cost vs. Long-Term ROI Themes can cost you under $100, but hidden limitations, plugin expenses, and maintenance costs can pile up. On the other hand, custom development costs more initially, but helps unlock higher ROI, better performance, and scalability. Hidden Costs in Pre-Built Themes Frequent plugin conflicts, dependent updates, or landing-poor performance can turn a cheap theme into a costly nightmare. Value-Added Benefits of Custom Development Agile loading, cleaner code, and customized features boost user engagement and conversion rates. If you consider the recent market statistics, the average annual WordPress developer salary in the USA can range from $ to $. Whereas, in India it can be far cost-effective ranging from $ to $ annually. Ideal Use Cases for Hiring a Developer There are several scenarios where custom development can shine. Some top use cases include: eCommerce Stores (WooCommerce Customization) Membership Portals LMS & eLearning Platforms Enterprise or Multi-Site WordPress Projects Sites with Custom Business Logic or Automation When your platform demands functionality beyond aesthetics a theme will never make the cut. Common Myths About Hiring Developers It’s Too Expensive Most hiring managers might assume that hiring a dedicated developer means spending tens of thousands upfront. Amidst the rising demand for WordPress developers , with offshore options and flexible contracts it becomes possible to get high-quality development at a fraction of the cost. Only Big Brands Need Developers Custom development is not just restricted to enterprises. Startups, SaaS companies, and solo entrepreneurs often need customized solutions that themes can’t offer. Hiring top WordPress developers can help build a stronger foundation, even for small-sized teams with bigger goals. Themes Are Always Easier and Faster Themes can be faster to launch but they often create bottlenecks when you need scalability or have to make changes. Custom development offers long-term flexibility and fewer plugin headaches saving time in the long run. To untangle these do’s and dont’s in the discussion of WordPress themes Vs custom development , hiring platforms like Uplers can be the right choice. You can hire top 3.5% WordPress developers that are vetted using AI and human intelligence from a 3M+ network. Hiring becomes seamless and effortless, all designed to ensure that you are investing only in what truly fits your needs. Let’s understand this choice in a little more detail. Why Choose Uplers? Unlike other job portals or hiring platforms in the market, Uplers stands unique with its AI-vetting process backed with human intelligence. Our platform has the largest private network of 3M+ STEM graduates from IIT, NIT, and renowned universities of India. We intend to cater as an end-to-end platform in bridging the talent gap between the scaling demand and scanty supply. By offering AI-vetted and AI-interviewed talent profiles within the first 2 days, matching the right WordPress developer for the job becomes effortless. Our AI algorithm also prepares a list of the questions you can ask in the interview with an option to customize them as per your job specifications or hiring needs. With top profiles in your inbox, a hiring questionnaire, a 30-days easy cancellation, a lifetime free talent replacement, onboarding assistance, and employer branding support, we are your one-stop hiring partner. Whether you are a SaaS startup or a scaling tech company, we help you hire top WordPress developers that match your technical and cultural needs efficiently and effectively. Final Call: Make the Right Choice for Your Business Choosing between a built-in WordPress theme and a dedicated developer is not just a budget decision, it’s a strategic one. closest.title: Director, Revenue Intelligence & Analytics
closest.text:
Overview

UPSTACK is the leading full-service technology advisory firm, transforming how businesses design, source, implement, support, and optimize IT infrastructure. Clients benefit from decades of expertise, enhanced support, and UPSTACK’s proprietary technology—delivering faster deployments, cost savings, and streamlined access to critical solutions.

Our expertise includes: data center colocation, network connectivity, SD-WAN, unified communications, cloud contact center, CX-AI, private/public cloud, security, mobility, business continuity, and IoT.

Under the leadership of Founder and CEO Christopher Trapp, UPSTACK is committed to exceptional customer experiences, serving 6,500+ clients—from SMBs to enterprises—and managing over $1B+ in annual technology spend across industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and analytical Director, Revenue Intelligence & Analytics to serve as a trusted partner to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) and Go-to-Market (GTM) leadership team. This leader will drive business performance through revenue intelligence, forecasting excellence, financial and operational analytics, and AI-driven insights.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in revenue operations, financial planning, and business analytics with the ability to influence executive decision-making. This role will lead forecasting governance, pipeline analytics, productivity measurement, partner economics, investment optimization, and strategic planning initiatives that support scalable revenue growth and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Intelligence & Forecasting

  • Own and continuously improve revenue forecasting models, including pipeline, bookings, revenue, and quota attainment.
  • Drive forecast rigor, governance processes, and forecasting methodologies across GTM leadership.
  • Lead pipeline inspection and deal review processes to improve forecast accuracy and predictability.
  • Analyze stage conversion rates, deal progression, slippage trends, and forecast variance.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasting processes in partnership with Finance and GTM leadership.

Sales Performance & Productivity Analytics

  • Develop sales capacity models, including headcount planning, quota allocation, territory coverage, and ramp productivity.
  • Evaluate sales productivity across segments, geographies, verticals, routes-to-market, and seller types.
  • Support compensation plan modeling, attainment analysis, and incentive effectiveness reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue-generating efficiency and resource allocation.

Strategic Growth & Market Analysis

  • Conduct Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) analysis, market segmentation, whitespace analysis, and growth opportunity modeling.
  • Analyze key SaaS business drivers including customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), funnel conversion, retention, and revenue growth metrics.
  • Develop financial and business models to support pricing strategy, territory planning, market expansion, and investment decisions.
  • Provide recommendations on GTM investments, territory design, and strategic growth initiatives.

Partner & Ecosystem Performance

  • Evaluate partner, channel, alliance, and ecosystem performance, including ROI and investment effectiveness.
  • Assess partner economics and recommend optimization strategies to maximize growth and profitability.

Executive Reporting & Business Insights

  • Lead analytics and reporting for forecast reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), executive operating reviews, and Board presentations.
  • Design and maintain executive dashboards and KPI reporting frameworks.
  • Deliver actionable insights on performance against targets, highlighting risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Translate complex data into clear, compelling executive-level narratives.

AI & Advanced Analytics

  • Leverage predictive analytics, AI-assisted forecasting, automation, anomaly detection, and scenario modeling to improve decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance business intelligence capabilities and operational efficiency through technology and analytics.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Business Systems & Data, and Finance teams to drive alignment and execution.
  • Support annual planning, budgeting, and long-range strategic planning processes.
  • Ensure data integrity, reporting consistency, and analytical rigor across the organization.
  • Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, systems, and reporting frameworks.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Revenue Analytics, FP&A, Business Intelligence, Sales Operations, or related strategic analytics functions.
  • Experience supporting executive leadership teams and influencing business strategy through data-driven insights.
  • Proven success in SaaS, subscription-based, or high-growth technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing forecasting, planning, and performance management processes.
  • Deep knowledge of:
    • Revenue Operations principles
    • Forecast governance and pipeline management
    • Territory design and sales capacity planning
    • Compensation and incentive design
    • Partner and ecosystem business models
    • SaaS growth metrics and revenue architecture
    • FP&A, forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis
    • Revenue modeling concepts including ARR, MRR, bookings, churn, and pipeline metrics
    • GTM business models and sales performance measurement
  • Advanced proficiency with:
    • Salesforce
    • SQL
    • Snowflake
    • Gong
    • HubSpot
    • Marketo
    • Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI platforms
    • Excel and financial modeling tools
    • Predictive analytics and AI-enabled business analysis solutions
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong executive communication and data storytelling capabilities.
  • Ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong project management and prioritization abilities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to influence executive decision-making through quantitative analysis and strategic recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge assumptions and drive accountability through business inspection processes.
  • Experience balancing strategic planning with operational execution.
  • Strong business acumen with a focus on ROI-driven investment decisions.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.
  • Proven track record of identifying business risks and opportunities proactively.
  • Experience building scalable analytical frameworks and financial models that support company growth.
  • Ability to partner effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, operational excellence, and innovation.

Salary Range

Employees new to UPSTACK typically come in at the start of the pay range. UPSTACK focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure, which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills. 

The salary range for this role is $170,000.00 to $190,000.00 annually plus participation in the annual bonus program. Compensation includes base salary and benefits.
